ns2:section.sectionText: This course will open to all students in the Gies College of Business on Monday, November 14, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This course will open to Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering, Systems Engineering & Design and French Commercial students on Monday, November 21, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to all of campus to allow Business Minor and prospective Business Minor students the option to register for this elective not offered as an online option on Monday, November 28, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 10 reserved seats for Gies College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 20, 2023 at approximately 10:00 a.m. Any exchange students outside of Gies College of Business that register will be removed from the course. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
